name: wma-composer-perp
rationale: The wma-composer entry on a 2x SOL long on Jupiter Perps: opens when the four WMAs agree (50<100, 15<100, 15>30, 5>10 on 15s bars), out on a 3.1% trailing stop (well inside the 24.88% limit at 2x) or after 4 hours, since borrow grows every hour. 10 USD of collateral (20 USD of exposure) a time inside a 12 USD budget, so one position at a time; retired after 3 USD of loss.
